intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Gurgaon. This page uses official 2026 programme fees where they were opened, and recorded 2022 placements, in {{year}}.
Amity University Haryana vs K.R. Mangalam University for BBA is a same-city private university comparison. Official fees differ by programme, and the 2022 placement years are the same on both sides.

sections.heading: Amity University Haryana vs K.R. Mangalam University for BBA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose K.R. Mangalam University if you want official 2026-27 programme fees of ₹2.30 lakh a year for BBA Business Intelligence and Analytics, including the four-year honours version, and ₹2 lakh a year for BBA Marketing. The recorded 2022 row on this page is an average of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh, listed against BBA Entrepreneurship.

Choose Amity University Haryana if you want the Manesar campus and the official BBA (3 Continent) fee, listed as a first-year non-sponsored semester fee of ₹2.40 lakh, or ₹4.80 lakh for two semesters in that year. Records still show ₹2.60 lakh a year for the standard three-year BBA, which does not cleanly match the official four-year BBA Honours page at a first-year semester fee of ₹1.75 lakh. The recorded 2022 row is an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹30 lakh.

sections.heading: Fees: official figures and recorded year tuition
paragraphs: K.R. Mangalam University's official programme pages list a programme fee of ₹2.30 lakh a year for BBA (Business Intelligence and Analytics) and for BBA (Hons) Business Intelligence and Analytics, and ₹2 lakh a year for BBA Marketing. A recorded Travel and Tourism year fee of ₹1.70 lakh remains in our records and was not overwritten, because an official page for that title was not confirmed here.

Amity University Haryana's official BBA (3 Continent) page lists a first-year non-sponsored semester fee of ₹2.40 lakh. This page treats two semesters as ₹4.80 lakh for that year. The official BBA Honours page lists a first-year non-sponsored semester fee of ₹1.75 lakh, but that programme is a four-year honours course, so the older recorded ₹2.60 lakh year fee for the three-year BBA was left unchanged. Confirm the exact programme on the official admissions page.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Amity University Haryana has a recorded 2022 row, listed against BBA, with an average package of ₹6 lakh and a highest package of ₹30 lakh. K.R. Mangalam University has a recorded 2022 row, listed against BBA Entrepreneurship, with an average of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh.
These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise. The highest-package figures are far apart, so read each official report for the latest year and for the exact BBA programme.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Official K.R. Mangalam admissions pages mention a university entrance test and interview. Amity pages list Class 12 marks, and in some cases an essay and interview.
Read the current official admissions page for the exact BBA you want, including the three-continent and honours options.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Amity University Haryana is listed at Amity Education Valley, Manesar, Gurgaon. K.R. Mangalam University is listed on Sohna Road, Gurugram.
Both are in the Gurgaon area, on different campuses. Visit if commute will decide the choice.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want official 2026-27 year fees around ₹2 lakh to ₹2.30 lakh and a recorded 2022 average of ₹8 lakh, K.R. Mangalam University is the side we can quote more cleanly, after you confirm the official report for your specialisation.

If you want the Amity Manesar campus, use the official programme page for the exact BBA. The official 3 Continent semester fee is ₹2.40 lakh, and the recorded 2022 highest package is ₹30 lakh, which you should read with the official report.
Do not mix a four-year honours fee with a three-year programme fee, and do not invent a missing official total.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Amity University Haryana or K.R. Mangalam University, for BBA?
faqs.answer: K.R. Mangalam University has official 2026-27 programme fees of ₹2.30 lakh a year for BBA Business Intelligence and Analytics and ₹2 lakh a year for BBA Marketing, plus a recorded 2022 average of ₹8 lakh. Amity University Haryana has an official BBA (3 Continent) first-year semester fee of ₹2.40 lakh, a recorded 2022 average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹30 lakh, and a recorded ₹2.60 lakh year fee for the standard three-year BBA that does not cleanly match the official four-year honours page.

faqs.question: What is the official K.R. Mangalam BBA fee for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: Official programme pages list ₹2.30 lakh a year for BBA Business Intelligence and Analytics, including the honours version, and ₹2 lakh a year for BBA Marketing. Confirm the page for the exact specialisation.

faqs.question: What is the official Amity University Haryana BBA (3 Continent) fee?
faqs.answer: The official programme page lists a first-year non-sponsored semester fee of ₹2.40 lakh. Two semesters in that year come to ₹4.80 lakh. Confirm the page, which also noted that admission was not open at the time it was read.

faqs.question: How do 2022 placements compare?
faqs.answer: Amity University Haryana has a recorded average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹30 lakh. K.R. Mangalam University has a recorded average of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh, listed against BBA Entrepreneurship. Confirm the latest official reports.

faqs.question: Are the two campuses in the same part of Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: No. Amity University Haryana is listed at Manesar. K.R. Mangalam University is listed on Sohna Road, Gurugram. Confirm the teaching campus on each official site.

faqs.question: Does this page use an India Today rank as NIRF?
faqs.answer: No. An India Today rank appears in our records for Amity University Haryana, but this page does not treat it as a NIRF rank.
